_documentation: Read-only snapshot of NetSec events on the EISS Indico (https://indico.eiss-europa.com). Generated by scripts/sync-indico.py, run daily by .github/workflows/sync-indico.yml. DO NOT EDIT BY HAND — the next sync will overwrite. `annualConferences` is a year-keyed map of ESSC editions; each entry carries event metadata (title, dates, venue, URL) plus a `programme.days` structure consumed by the (still-to-build) live programme grid on the conference page. Schema mirrors EISS's indico.json for cross-site renderer compatibility — see https://github.com/EISSeuropa/EISSeuropa.github.io/blob/master/docs/indico-programme-integration.md.
